# Guidance for Amina (Grade 6, Hillview Primary)

## Headline

Amina is doing well. Two things to work on this week: adding fractions and adding decimals.

## Focus 1: Make the bottoms match, then add

**What to do:** Make the bottoms match first, then add only the tops.

**Why:** Amina adds the tops and bottoms together instead of making the bottoms match first.

**Evidence:** Class Test 1 · Q1, Q2, Q4 (result IDs: 33aa9d98-68d8-4d52-a942-a3c6778e2ed3, 50e25de8-2ba9-4afc-b65e-3af1a3aa1ef4, b8de312c-354c-4750-b3db-e24ded6b9eb0)

## Focus 2: Line up the comma in decimals

**What to do:** Line up the comma so each digit is worth the right amount.

**Why:** Amina lines up the last digits instead of the comma.

**Evidence:** Class Test 1 · Q8 (result ID: 69446b81-d576-4304-bbda-fb9adacd8c2e); Homework · Sunday (result IDs: 1f3b4d28-5a83-4e11-ae2e-ded6855d6d1d, 587384c8-9ca5-46de-b451-9cee912754f6)

## Looking Ahead

Next she will multiply fractions and work with percentages, so these two skills are worth fixing now.

## Notes

- Amina's teacher notes that she works well in a group and explains her thinking clearly (Ms Banda, 5 November 2026).
- Amina plays netball on Tuesdays and Thursdays and sings in the school choir on Fridays.
- Marks are not changed by this card.
